## Houston v0.6.4

- Switching team spaces now keeps Mission Control smooth without false missing-agent errors.
- Moonshot AI keys now connect reliably and start with the supported Kimi K3 model.
- Team owners can permanently delete eligible team spaces when the service supports it.
- Stability and polish improvements under the hood.

### Before you upgrade

- Quit Houston before installing. macOS does not always replace an app that is running.
